articles.title: California voters fail to pass proposed one-time tax on billionaires’ wealth
articles.summary:
Campaign over Prop 40, as measure was known, was most expensive in state history, flush with Silicon Valley dollars

California billionaires won a contentious ballot measure campaign, defeating a proposed one-time tax on their wealth.

The bruising campaign over Proposition 40 was the most expensive in state history and witness to back-and-forth dealing from tech billionaires and democratic leaders, including Gavin Newsom, the governor, who steadfastly opposed the measure. While supporters of Prop 40 cast it as a solution to drastic healthcare cuts from Trump’s One Big Beautiful Bill Act, opponents led by prosperous billionaires mounted an influential campaign saying the billionaire tax was instead “an everyone tax”.

articles.title: Senate advances bill to speed up projects from gas pipelines to clean energy
articles.summary:
Key environmental groups come out against bipartisan Baaja bill over fears it could spur datacenters and ICE jails

The Senate on Monday advanced bipartisan legislation aimed at speeding up permitting reviews for datacenters and other infrastructure projects, in the first major action since last week’s election that soundly repudiated Donald Trump and congressional Republicans.

It’s a bill that would make it easier to build big infrastructure projects in America – everything from fossil fuel pipelines to transmission lines that would add more clean energy to the grid. And it would roll back environmental and social protections to achieve this goal. That is why climate advocates are torn over the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs act (Baaja).

archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat zostřenou rétoriku mezi nově posíleným Kongresem a Bílým domem, přičemž trhy budou nadále vyhodnocovat inflační tlaky a kroky Fedu.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, sharpened rhetoric between the newly empowered Congress and the White House is expected, while markets continue to assess inflation pressures and Fed actions.

archive.security_status_cs: Spojené státy se vyrovnávají s výsledky nedávných sněmovních voleb, které přinesly demokratickou většinu a nutí Bílý dům k přehodnocení dosavadní politiky. Prezident Donald Trump připustil, že jeho imigrační a deportační opatření byla příliš přísná, což otevírá prostor pro politická vyjednávání s novým Kongresem. Mezitím technologický sektor čelí zvýšenému dohledem kvůli geopolitickým vazbám a mezinárodní kybernetické hrozby testují kritickou infrastrukturu.
archive.security_status_en: The United States is adjusting to the aftermath of recent midterm elections that delivered a Democratic majority and forced the White House to recalibrate its policy approach. President Donald Trump conceded that his immigration and deportation policies were too tough, opening the door for political negotiations with the incoming Congress. Meanwhile, the technology sector faces heightened scrutiny over geopolitical ties, and international cyber threats continue to test critical infrastructure.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se očekává zostřená politická rétorika a vyjednávání mezi Bílým domem a nově zvoleným Kongresem ohledně legislativních priorit.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, heightened political rhetoric and negotiations between the White House and the newly empowered Congress regarding legislative priorities are expected.

archive.security_status_cs: Spojené státy procházejí obdobím zvýšené politické nestability po porážce republikánů v midterms, která vede k personálním čistkám, výzvám k impeachmentu ministra obrany Hegsetha a tvrdému střetu v Kongresu. Akciové trhy vykazují vysokou volatilitu, kterou přiživují obavy z regulace technologického sektoru a skandál kolem šéfa Nvidie, zatímco Nejvyšší soud povolil pokračování stavby hraniční zdi v Turecku.
archive.security_status_en: The United States is experiencing a period of heightened political instability following the GOP's midterm defeat, which has triggered personnel overhauls, impeachment pushes against Defense Secretary Hegseth, and intense congressional clashes. Stock markets exhibit high volatility fueled by tech sector regulatory fears and the Nvidia CEO scandal, while the Supreme Court allowed border wall construction to proceed.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující volatilitu na akciových trzích a zostřený boj v Kongresu mezi posílenými demokraty a administrativou.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, expect continued stock market volatility and intensified congressional battles between the empowered Democrats and the administration.
